title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: a late declaration fee is booked while the acceptance is under review
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product a late declaration is charged once it has been accepted for the sailing, which the acceptance's record shows by its review having started. The fee is booked while the acceptance is under review, because a declaration signed after the late-acceptance deadline is not accepted and leaves the acceptance submitted, and a late declaration fee may be booked only while the acceptance is submitted or under review, so a decided acceptance can no longer be charged.

## Status of the acceptance and the late fee
| Acceptance status | Late declaration fee chargeable now |
|---|---|
| submitted | no — the record does not show review started, so it does not show the declaration accepted for the sailing |
| under review | yes, where the judged declaration is late and not yet charged |
| approved or rejected | no — the acceptance is decided |
| any other status | no |

## Reading the rule as condition → reason
- Review has started → the late declaration has been accepted for the sailing → the fee can be booked.
- The application is still submitted after a late signature → the declaration was signed after the late-acceptance deadline and not accepted → no fee.
- The review has been decided → the time in which a late fee may be booked has passed → no fee.

## Points of judgement
- *The line has already approved the acceptance, and the late fee was never booked — can it be booked now?* No; a decided acceptance can no longer be charged a late declaration fee.
